reported.title: Flow not scaled to L/h
reported.description: readFlowLph returns raw ADC counts instead of converting to millivolts (counts * 5000/1023) and dividing by 2 mV/Lph, so printed flow and alarm threshold are wrong by a large factor.

reported.title: Logging every 2 s instead of 500 ms
reported.description: loop uses delay(2000) and logs unconditionally, so serial output occurs every ~2 s, violating the 500 ms logging requirement and the 900 ms silence limit.

reported.title: Alarm threshold uses raw counts
reported.description: flowLooksLow compares raw ADC counts against 100 L/h, so the alarm state does not correspond to the actual flow in L/h.

reported.title: No hysteresis on alarm
reported.description: The alarm turns off immediately when flow rises above 100 L/h (and the HIGH_FLOW_LPH branch is redundant), causing chatter around the threshold; a hysteresis band is needed.

truth.description: Treats raw ADC counts as L/h

judge_input.spec:
- Flow transducer on A0 scaled at 2 mV/Lph; low-flow alarm lamp on D8.
- Convert ADC with a 5.000 V / 1023 span, then divide millivolts by 2 to obtain L/h.
- Print `flow: <value>` every 500 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed flow must match the injected value within ±10 L/h.
- Drive D8 HIGH when flow is below 100 L/h; otherwise LOW.
- Firmware must never go silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 900 ms.
